Bihar Recruitment Exams Announced by BPSC and BPSSC

The Bihar Public Service Commission (BPSC) has announced the preliminary examination for Assistant Prosecution Officer (APO) will be held on July 15, 2026. Admit cards for this exam are scheduled for release on July 9, 2026. Additionally, the Bihar Police Subordinate Services Commission (BPSSC) will conduct a Havildar Instructor exam on July 29, with admit cards to be issued on an unspecified date. Both commissions are facilitating recruitment opportunities in Bihar.
